front.title: AI Terms: Per-Use Terms, Payment and Receipts for Automated AI Access to Web Content

abstract.t: This document defines AI Terms: a JSON document published at the well-known URI /.well-known/ai-terms in which a website states, for each of four uses of its content by automated AI systems (search, answer, training and agent), whether the use is allowed, allowed for a price, or not allowed. It also defines an AI-Purpose request header with which a client declares the use it intends, a way to point to the terms from any HTTP response, and how a paid access produces a receipt that records the use. AI Terms is designed to sit alongside the Robots Exclusion Protocol and the usage-preference vocabulary of the IETF AI Preferences work, adding the pieces those leave out: price, payment binding, purpose declaration by the client, and a record of licensed use.
